### Architect · Answer

Event: `d7f305c84fb256372b54129f652df938` · 2026-09-29T10:03:00Z

> API1 facts and draft: .wash/local/API1-design.md (Rhai built in /tmp/api1; nothing in the tree).
> 
> Rhai 1.26.1, MIT/Apache: builds no_std+alloc for rv64 and rv32 (checked), and native registration is easy (register_fn). It fails "no unsafe": 4 sites of its own, ~2,000 unsafe lines in deps it cannot drop (hashbrown, smallvec, thin-vec, smartstring, portable-atomic, zerocopy). Size ~48K + ~88K of deps. smartstring is MPL-2.0. ahash bakes a build-time random seed (it must be pinned for a reproducible build). Alternatives: rust_lisp forbids unsafe but needs std, dead since 2022; blisp is no_std but has 37 unsafe GC lines. Nothing mature fits.
> 
> Shape: one crate, redoubt-client (libs/client), no_std+alloc, zero unsafe, blocking, over rt + wire. Modules first: ns, file (9P), fsd (typed ops that name fids, which must be Rust), console, launch (StartupBuilder, Job), grants (the launcher ledger wire.md plans), typed (a generic call over any generated codec). beamlet's Platform and natives are thin adapters; typed server calls stay Elixir over generated codecs, as beamlet.md settles. Facade decisions settled: the namespace owns connections (bind shares); no file buffering; no lookup cache; no reconnect (Disconnected; the launcher regrants); connections shared across threads with per-call buffers (splits rt's Client); sink checks stay in servers; one error type; no second encoder.
> 
> Host tests: yes. The rt fake kernel becomes a dev crate; tests run real bootfsd, consoled and keyd on it, and beamlet's Redoubt Platform is tested the same way.
> 
> Placement: API1, M1, Tier A, M; needs S3 (it touches rt's client); init and beamlet-redoubt need it; independent of gate and fsd.
> 
> Owner choice (sec. 5): a script language as a third userland? Recommend NOT NOW. API1 stays bindable by any language; Elixir on beamlet (already safe Rust) is the scripting language. Alternatives: Rhai (~140K lines, unsafe, Tier A) or our own small language. Ready to file as a decision_request, or you fold it in.

### Orchestrator · Owner decision requested

Event: `86cfdd513cdbb53eef74971ed63bf1a2` · 2026-09-29T10:03:12Z

> API1: one client crate for every userland, and a script language (design: .wash/local/API1-design.md)
> 
> 1. Build API1 as drafted? It's one crate, redoubt-client (libs/client): no_std with alloc, zero unsafe, blocking, over the runtime and the wire codecs. Modules first: namespaces, files (9P), fsd's typed ops, the console, launching (StartupBuilder, Job), the launcher's grant ledger, and a generic typed call. beamlet's platform and natives become thin adapters over it. Decisions it settles: the namespace owns its connections; no buffering, lookup cache or reconnect (a disconnect is reported and the launcher regrants); connections are shared across threads; one error type; sink checks stay in the servers. It's tested on the host with real bootfsd, consoled and keyd running on the runtime's fake kernel. It's an M1 package, Tier A, size M; init and beamlet-redoubt wait for it. It's independent of the gate and fsd, so it can start now.
>    - Yes, start now (recommended): Parallel with K8; init and beamlet-redoubt then need it
>    - Yes, after the gate: Keep the kernel work first
>    - Change the shape: Say what, in your own words
> 2. A small script language as another userland? Rhai 1.26 builds no_std for both targets and registers natives easily, but it fails no-unsafe: 4 unsafe sites of its own, and about 2,000 unsafe lines in dependencies it can't drop (hashbrown, smallvec, smartstring and others). It's about 140K lines with its dependencies, smartstring is MPL-2.0, and its ahash seed must be pinned for reproducible builds. Nothing mature is no_std and unsafe-free (rust_lisp needs std and has been dead since 2022; blisp has 37 unsafe lines in its GC). Elixir on beamlet is already a safe-Rust scripting language.
>    - Not now (recommended): API1 stays bindable by any language; Elixir is the scripting language
>    - Rhai anyway: Accept ~140K vendored lines and their unsafe, Tier A
>    - Our own tiny language: A small interpreter, no_std, forbid(unsafe): a new package later
